parsed.why: Removed all state gender-identity protections and barred local remedies; school birth-certificate facility rule; worst-risk tier. No documented adult public-facility criminal ban, but hostile climate and no recourse.

Most restrictive: statewide order applies birth-sex rules to all state facilities, shelters, custody; public funds and facilities barred from adult care; no discrimination or hate-crime protection. Universal-exposure layers.

Second-highest risk tier; K-12 and college facility law by birth certificate, though no enforcement mechanism; care-ban litigation; patchy local protections. Less severe than statewide facility and custody regimes.
Most Protective tier: no bathroom ban, broad gender-identity civil rights, hate-crime coverage, X markers, shield law. National border and custody exposure remains, so not Reduced Risk.

Most Protective plus comprehensive insurance and shield laws, but documented prison practice returning a trans woman to a men's facility as punishment, plus pending anti-trans ballot measures. Slightly below dossier 4.
